input.title: NSCC rule change on ACATS for insurance and retirement products
input.summary: NSCC filed a proposed rule change with immediate effectiveness concerning the Automated Customer Account Transfer Service (ACATS) account transfer process for insurance and retirement products, published in the Federal Register on 2026-11-02.
evidence_quotes: Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change Concerning the Automated Customer Account Transfer Service Account Transfer Process for Insurance and Retirement Products
input.notes: headline_only. The rule change has immediate effectiveness, so certainty is 2. Reach set to 1 (business_line) as the change is scoped to a specific product segment (insurance and retirement products) within ACATS, not all account transfers. Effect date set to announced date as no separate effective date is stated in the text.
